review_description: A successful project often relies on a combination of a good product/supplier and good client working together.  Living in a Body Corporate (BC) run community, installation could not start until BC approval had been granted.  So, after an exhaustive delay - which means I, as the customer, didn't exactly make the kick-off date for the project any easier, the Sure Solar team got stuck in as soon as possible.Communication between them and myself, was excellent, with consistent updates and confirmation texts being sent in the lead-up to installation.On the day, the installation team Lead by Steve B arrived exactly on time.  Communication was top notch, and the team went about their business without any fuss.  There are always decisions to be made about placement of conduit, wires and inverter etc. and Steve took the time to provide options and suggestions - bringing his experience and knowledge into the advice he provided.Once installed, Steve took the time to demo the system. Every scrap of packaging and off-cuts were removed and the area was left looking clean and neat.Highly recommend both the Installation team and sales process from Jason

From quote to finish ,This company has got to be the best i have ever dealt with.Excellent customer service, Excellent work.Steve the electrician ,hold your head up high your customer service, your excellent work ethics, I could not fault you.Neat,tidy, happy excellent workWill recomend this company to all.Straightforward ,no crap, no exuses Job done perfectly.Thank you for restoring our faith in businesses

After contact with Sure Solar Pty Ltd occured after my researching companies and getting recommedations from other satified customers.The initial contact with Sure Solar resulted in a professional and personal inspection of my home. This was important to me.Followed up by informative and timely correspondence including the quote.I received multiple messages about the install. The install team were on time, courteous and also professionalThe install seems to be of a good standard. The job site was cleaned up and the guys helped us with the install of the App on our phones and explained how our new system works.I really have nothing adverse I good say about my experience with this company and I recommend people looking to install solar, look at Sure Solar Pty Ltd, while doing their research.

The quoting process was excellent, with clear communication and timely follow-up before installation. They provided several options and responded promptly. The installation went smoothly — the team was polite, punctual, and tidy. Overall, customer service was good.

Sure Solar guys actually listened to my very specific requirements and offered 3 solutions for my consideration. Took the time to walk me through each option without any pressure to proceed.Very Helpful and stress-free discission making.The installation team kept me updated on arrival time and progress of install.All in all, very happy with the process and the follow up after was much appreciated

The guys came and installed 13kW of panels plus battery, all in less than a day. Very impressive organisation.  I had a good run-through of the system operation afterwards, including instructions on how to isolate the solar components, which is important if anyone else is doing electrical work in the place.We had a little trouble with our system initially, but the guys were on it as soon as we raised it, and now the system is working nicely.The Solaredge app makes it far to easy to become obsessed with exactly what your system is doing at any time :).Very happy overall.

I’m really pleased with overall process and dealing with Sure Solar. I’m particularly impressed wiith Cody who led me on the whole journey. The installation was smooth and in time. Cody particularly with good knowledge ensured I got the right system.

I had Sure Solar install a system for me in April 2024. The system has been excellent. After the system was installed, the Sales Representative (Jason) said if you ever want to check on how your energy provider is tracking, just give me a call and I will advise you the best way possible. So, I contacted Jason the other day, and true to his word he has outlined some details for me to coordinate with my energy provider or a new one if needed. Now that's service. Allan K (Currumbin Waters)

Reached out to Sure Solar about 5 years ago to get a quote.  Then we decided to knock down and rebuild.Jason from Sure Solar kept in contact every 6 months to see how out build was going (over budget and late was the answer :( ).  Once our new house was built I had them quote again. Jason knew the technical side of things very well which gave me extreme comfort that I was talking to a company that knows its stuff.The dollars looked good and the customer service all lined up for me so I signed the contract.The 13.2kw system has been in for over a year now.  We make loads of power that we do our best to burn -  AC and Pool.  However the feed in tariffs are so small, its time to capture my excess for my own needs.  So now time for a big battery -  25Kwh.  It will be installed in November.I can recommend Jason at Sure Solar!

The process was smooth and seamless. From the sales staff to the installation. All the work was finished promptly, everyone had their job to do, and did it very well. Sure Solar Sydney answered all our questions and always got back with the information that we needed. Everyone cleaned up after themselves, it was nice to see.

Jason was great to deal with! He was patient with me and my hundreds of questions and helped me make my decision after much deliberation over a long period of time? Great installation and so far everything has been great!
This whole process has been so easy. From organising a quote to having a working system everything was done efficiently and courteously. I would recommend Sure Solar highly.

Sales /quote process was prompt.Installation was punctual & polite.  However, there was minimal explanation & demonstration in terms of how to properly & safety operate the system eg. Shutdown procedures, purpose of different switches etc...Customer service was satisfactory.  However, I needed to chase up for the after installation documentation pack.
Nick and the team at Sure Solar were awesome, definitly recommend. The system was delivered and installed ahead of schedule.

Cody from Sure Solar was great to deal with from start to finish. I had multiple quotes from solar companies with pushy salesman's. Cody was the complete opposite and answered all of my questions without the pressure. Luckily i called Sure Solar, I ended up with a quality system with battery for thousands less than all other quotes and without the pressure to sign a contract. I am now receiving free power, goodbye $300 a month power bills.

I got a quote from Sure Solar through SolarQuotes. Jason from Sure Solar was very helpful in explaining the technical ins and outs but also the difference between cheap $6000 battery systems and the more expensive but much better quality ones they use.Sure Solar was very flexible with how I wanted to set up my system to add to in the future.The install crew were very thorough and after they left it was spotless.thanks for the great  job.
Nick in sales was excellent answering all my questions immediately even on the weekend.Installation went perfectly. On time and helpful.Customer service was good.

Thank you Solar Quotes for leading me to Sure Solar and the Federal Government's Battery Rebate Scheme. I evaluated 3 quotes and chose Sure Solar although they weren't the cheapest quote.From first contact through to commissioning the battery the level of personalised service was outstanding. They met all my requirements and performed the installation much quicker than I expected. Every tradesperson involved was easy to talk to and actually listened. The company owner, Daniel and engineer Griffun attended to commission the battery and explained precisely how the system operated. I was provided with a full set of documents pertaining to all aspects of the system. I feel that every dollar I have invested is well spent and have complete confidence in Sure Solar to honour any warranty issues although I don't expect to have any. I could not be happier with my choice of solar installer.
From start to finish everything was great .They organised everything from grid connection to getting the electrical contractor out to do a pre inspection.

The sales/quoting process was very professional and they answered all my questions promptly and they were very friendlyInstallation was also very professional and friendlyThey are due to come back soon to turn on the batteryI am sure they will once again answer my questions and provide me with all the information I needCustomer service has so far been excellent

The Sure Solar team planned constructively with me to remove the old system and coordinate around other work on our house. The removal and new installation went very smooth. We valued the expert advice on system layout and capacity provided by Sure Solar. Our system including the battery is working well with a reduction in our power load ranging from 20 from 30 kWhr per day resulting in purchased energy of 0 to 10 kWhr.

We had a great experience with Sure Solar from start to finish. The team was friendly, easy to deal with, and really knew their stuff. They took the time to walk us through everything and came up with a system that suits our home perfectly.What really stood out was the extra thought they put into our setup—especially around our hot water system. It wasn’t something we’d given much thought to, but they picked up on it straight away and made sure it was factored into the design to get the most out of the solar. That kind of attention to detail really impressed us.The install was quick and tidy, and everything’s been working like a dream since. We’ve already noticed a drop in our power bills.All in all, we’re super happy we went with Sure Solar. Great service, great team, and a solid product. Would definitely recommend them to anyone thinking about going solar.

From the initial consultation to the final installation, the process with Sure Solar was smooth and straightforward.  They didn't try to oversell with things we didn't need, and took the time to look into our usage.  The system recommended made sense compared to what some of the other companies suggested.We had a slight configuration change required after the site inspection on installation day, to put some panels on the south facing rather than the east.  This was communicated clearly and the team handled it efficiently. The team were exceptionally friendly and courteous, got it done fast, ensuring everything was completed to a high standard. I had some questions after installation and they were handled quickly.We're very happy with our new solar panel system.

Sure solar was one of my three companies from Finn when I Was moving from Sydney to Brisbane. Nick From sure Solar was brilliant with firming up what I wanted in terms of number of panels and larger modular battery (19.2kWH). The new system was installed in December. Can’t speak highly enough of the install.The system had it’s baptism of fire this week courtesy of cyclone Alfred. The panels didn’t move in the cyclonic conditions and the battery kept the house powered up for the three days I was without power.If you are in the Brisbane area and you are not using Sure Solar, you are crazy.
Jason is very easy to talk to, and very understanding. The customer service that was offered was superb and I would 100% recommend this company to anyone wanting to get solar.

After review of several solar provider quotations I decided to progress with Sure Solar. This was due to being comfortable after discussion with Nick on pricing, product performance & quality. I also had confidence knowing the business was solid based on time in business, other reviews and watching the MD on Youtube and understanding his values and business ethics.The installation team were a great bunch of guys who introduced themselves individually on arrival and professionally installed the system. I was shown all aspects of app and system management on completion. Whilst only installed in the last few days it is operating to quoted specifications.I don't have any hesitation in recommending Sure Solar based on my dealings.

Nick and the team from Sure Solar were professional and helpful for my solar installation. From the initial quote through to post-installation, it has been a great experience with excellent customer service.The solar system that Sure Solar sized and installed for me has worked like a dream and eliminated by energy bill - 10/10 would use them again.

Got my 15kw system installed earlier this year and it has been working like a dream. Got longi panels with sungrow inverter. All setup and tracking through the iSolar app. So far has been producing well above estimates given during quote. Had them come in install brackets first and then got roof painted. They came back and finished the system install over two separate days (due to high winds). Also got some timers for the hot water systems installed with a separate switch board for all the new items.
Overall process was good. Some issues with the initial inverter app configuration but was able to be solved remotely after notifying them. Overall recommend their service.
From first contact to final install & commissioning of the system the whole process was effortlessly carried out. No hesitation to recommend them!

Sure Solar did a great quality install. From quotation to after install the customer service was magnificent! The installers were professional and tidy and did a great job. I’m really happy I chose Sure Solar and thoroughly recommend them to anybody considering installing solar.

From the point of getting quotes (I got 5 in total ) Sure solar had the best attention to detail, options to ensure what I needed and helped me understand my needs as well. Jason in sales was attentive, Tim the lead on the day had the team get my system up in a day.The service was supportive at every point.

Daniel from Sure Solar has been great to work with. Was really pleased with some thinking outside of the box when it came to install position, quality of this finished product looks top notch and he’s been a pleasure to deal with. Very happy

I was impressed with the customer support, attention to detail and informative communication at all steps of the process. This was my first solar installation. Sales and quoting process was straight forward and all my questions were answered promptly and was very helpful. I would recommend Sure Solar.

My experience with the sure solar team has been fantastic every time. I had a previous installer who was happy to take my money. If you want an authentic installer who genuinely cares then give the team at sure solar a go.Dana

They spent the extra time to make the cable conduit look good, rather than doing a quick job. Quality price and easy to deal with.I chose Sure Solar because they explained why what I originally asked for was not necessarily the best for my objectives. Furthermore, they backed their opinion up with research and sources. They delivered on a best practice solar system.

Very professional - explained all aspects, pros/cons of solar systems and what would best suit our family's needs.No hard sellVery neat, tidy installation.Great customer service before AND after sale.

Excellent battery installation to complete the job after last years Solar Panels.Very happy with the tidy and punctual installation and the help we were given along the way.I would recommend this team to anyone...

I chose Sure Solar, as the price was good and the sales person was friendly.  It turns out the salesperson was only interested in the sale.There were some issues with the placement of the battery in relation to the existing gas cylinders, and I said that we might have to cancel the install, because we were not made aware of that at the start.  They called me and assured me that if we were to move the gas bottles down the wall, everything would be okay.So I organised a gas plumber to come and move the bottles.  On the day of the battery/solar install the gas plumber came, and said the even in the new location the bottles were too close (according to the gas regulations), and that his original quote of $800 no longer stands as he will have to move the gas to the other side of the path, and the estimate was $3000.I tried to contact Sure Solar to discuss, and it was only once I sent an email to the owner that I got a response.  They came to look at the setup and was adamant that the original gas bottle location met the regulations, and it was done to interpretations.It doesn't matter how you interpret the regulations, it matters how the person issuing the certificate interprets it.Don't use Sure Solar, they are arrogant and are only interested in the sale, and can't handle installs that are more complicated.

I was given a great quote. But instead of 4 weeks to install it became 6 weeks. Then they didn't finish on the same day, they had to return the following week. There were some bolts left behind on the roof. I'm happy with the Jinko panels and Sungrow inverter. I would do business with them again despite a few bumps.

I was originally concerned when this company advised they didn't do onsite previsits.  However I found that I had a really good relationship with the Sales Team Manager who was more than happy to talk about any questions or queries I had.Once I'd agreed on final system and price, I was even able to arrange a preinstall to fit the solar panel brackets as I was having my roof restored, and this was at no further cost.All timelines were advised in advance with only the wet weather delaying the install, but not substantially.I was taken through all the hardware - Inverter and Battery, plus shown the app to manage my system.  I was also advised that part of the install involved a continued monitoring by the company to ensure that the system was operating at its optimum performance.I also received a follow-up email to ensure that I arranged for my Smart Meter installation by my Energy Provider.

Good response and best quote for a replacement PV system from Sure Solar. A bit more expensive than the standard install due to removal of the existing one but worth it for a quality install. Process from quote to install was quick and easy and the installer was very good. Everything worked as it should from the start and no issues with the quality of the panels or inverter, both offering good warranties.

Jason was our saler. We contacted him for a quote 5 months ago for a house we were going to buy. But it didn't happen. Instead we waited 2 more months to finally move in to our new house. Jason got in touch with us just before we moved in and was very helpful in giving us the best options possible for our needs. He also advised us on what option will be the most profitable for us and suitable for our budget. We got 10.6kw trina vertex S+ solar panels,sungrow hybrid inverter and the sungrow 9.6kw battery. We really appreciated his insight. Very knowledgeable. Very easy to get answers to our questions during the process and installation but also after the installation was completed. Jonathan and his team did a great job installing the panels and the battery system. Punctual, polite, neat and tidy. We had a outage last night, the battery kicked in, we didn't even realised there was no power until the next morning. It was a great test to see if everything was functioning properly. The price for the whole installation was reasonable. He also helped us getting the battery rebate. We couldn't be happier with everything. Highly recommended!!!

Provider had slick processes but lack of attention to detail let them down, namely:-- Installer arrived a day earlier than agreed - luckily I was home that day- Installer arrived with wrong brand of panels (Jinko instead of JA Solar)- this led to vigorous discussions on a 'quote & switch scenario'. Allegedly panels installed were of equal or better quality- Installer entered wrong email address into the setup of the Solar Catch relay account thus I couldn't access the device / account. Support staff at vendor slow to respond to this issue.Installer left system on when they left - which they shouldn't have prior to meter upgradeGenerally the process was easy - albeit with some hick-ups and the need to monitor them, with sales staff helpful with questions about future battery install.2 weeks after install, still waiting for Ergon (retailer)  to upgrade meter, so I can turn the system on again.

The sales process was very good with all my questions answered. The Installation was done in a day for the panels and battery. They were punctual and tidy. They worked well together as a team and were polite. The grid connection was all pre-arranged so it was connect the new replacement system up and away it went.
,my roof is 16 years old,the tiles arenot at there best,after installation,he examined the roof aand patch up some sunken caps.

All aspects  of my dealings with Sure Solar exceeded  my expectations. I was particularly impressed by the installation  team who worked  together very efficiently and listened  to my concerns and implemented  or improved my suggestions.

Overall both Auswell energy and Suresolar were very helpful & patient in explaining the details of the proposal to me. Both were very co-operative. However the third suggested company Solar EZE sent a quote once without any further follow ups so I decided not to deal with them.It appeared that Suresolar’s price was a bit cheaper & the sale person was more knowledgeable. The sale person from Auswell was also very approachable & helpful.Sure solar organised on time to get the bracket installed just before my roof restoration. The electrician was very professional, punctual , tidy , worked efficiently and effectively to get the job done in a timely manner.  Due to the time constraints Sure Solar had to use a contract electrician to get the job done which shows that Suresolar is willing to get the job done as was agreed in the contract.Suresolar organised the grid connection and very soon my meter to be updated.I am very happy my solar & very grateful from SolarQuotes for suggesting these companies to me.Kind RegardsGiti

Sales guy knew his stuff and gave me the information I needed. Was happy to take follow up calls. Was friendly and not pushy.Installer was on time and did a fantastic job. Looks really neat and tidy, didn’t mind me asking questions, left no mess and no rubbish behind.Literally everything was done for me, no issues and no fuss.

Great company listened well to my needs and compared with 6 quotes they came out on top. System is working well with catch solar relay.The guys installing the panels were excellent working in with space constraints.  The only things that need to be improved was quoting sent a photo of the switch board to the quoter but on installation day had to upgrade switchboard for extra cost. Installer needs more wiring training with catch solar relay as went 24hrs without hot water due to this.

We were very happy with the sales/quoting process and at no time felt any sales pressure and very easy to get answers for our questions.The installers turned up on time and the whole process completed in a timely manner and whilst they did have an incorrect part this was did not effect the workings of the unit and a delightful young gentleman came back and changed over the part. It was all to do with 3 phase (which we had) and a single phase part.
I found Suresolar to be reliable and professional.  Just had my solar installed. Great customer service from start to finish. Happy with purchase and looks great on the house

We thank Solar quotes for offering the servive of several providers, amd though we chose Sure Solar, all seemed very capable and professional and knowledgable.Sure Solar were so helpful, prompt and flexible in installing the Solar and doing so while we were building. I do highly recommend there service.

Where to start? Well, first thing I did was seek quotes through solarquotes.com.au that netted 2 great companies plus one I sought independently. Sure Solar stood out from day 1 albeit I was sceptical. I asked all three companies a tonne of questions via email and consistently Sure Solar not only answered every question asked, but did so within 20 minutes max regardless of being a weekday or weekend. The other two companies took 2-4 days to respond.Our requirements started off basic, but as we became more educated through our own research we kept raising the bar with system upgrades. Sure Solar produced more than 6 quotes through this time while the other companies were becoming obviously less responsive to changes.The initial quotes recieved from all 3 were actually very close, in fact they were all within 5% difference from highest to lowest. Sure Solar were right in the middle but effectively they were all very close.Eventually it became very obvious that Sure Solar were not only customer focused, but were incredibly patient and never once did they not respond to our ridiculous amount of emails asking questions and changing system specs.In the end, we went with a complex system and we challenged Sure Solar to develop a solution that provided a seemless single unitary benefit from a dual inverter arrangement with 4 panel strings and two separate battery stacks across our house's 2 Phase load configuration such that the individual inverters and battery stacks merged as one system for output benefit yet worked separately as an optimised 4 channel input production plant making use of 3 different roof orientations.We chose a full Sungrow System for all components accept the panel optimiser modules which are not yet available fron Sungrow. Sure Solar's Senior Engineer worked with Sungrow to nut out what has ended up being exactly what we wanted. Sure Solar were obviously very capable and were confident a solution would be had, and they delivered on every promise made.The company founder took the time to call me twice throughout the project period, their Head Engineer spoke several times over the phone and attended site twice while progressing a solution, and performed remote diagnostics and configurations. The salesman was a legend answering every question in amazing time and never started with "No" instead, he would say "let me speak to the engineer and see what we can do". The installers were excellent, especially the team lead, he was punctual, explained everything, and took care in ensuring nothing less than a first class installation. The administration team were great, no hassle invoicing and never any pressure applied.Never in my life have I left such detailed feedback for any company, but these guys were like I found that needle in a haystack...! My wife and I have high expectations that often are said to be unrealistic, but Sure Solar exceeded our expectations. Thank you Sure Solar, we are customers for life while ever you maintain such excellent customer service.Sincerely, Allan and Sharon

From the initial online request I was contacted the following day. No hassle of waiting for someone to come out s as no quote, sent through photos needed and done. Installed with no issues, great friendly service. Definitely recommend.

Great sales and service, answered all questions gave great options, provided great communication and arrived on time, crew was awesome and Supervisor great too.. after service was and is great. Everything thing taken care of by trades

A simple sales process, guided by Nick from Sure Solar, who answered all my questions and requests for further information on why each individual component was being recommended.A quality installation team who were happy to ask where the components were to be put and did everything to meet my requirements.  My expectations were surpassed.All conversations that they could carry out with the grid were carried out seemlessly by Sure Solar, and made entirely painless.  Indeed the part I was meant to do, contacting Origin to arrange for a new meter seems to have happened too, perhaps they noticed some power heading their way!

From our request for a quote, to energising the system on our roof, was so easy.After the success of that install on our home in Brisbane, we put it on our farm property as well. We purchase two 5Kw systems within 3 months and both are working well.Thank you Sure Solar, it works well and was completed when you said it would be done.

Sure Solar we’re amazing. Nick the rep and Steve the installer were incredible. They made the whole process simple and easy. They were super helpful and answered all my questions and patient with going through process. I would recommend to anyone wanting fantastic professional and customer service

Quote process was smooth and fast. I was offered multiple options that were well explained and this allowed me to make a decision around the system with confidence. Responses to queries were quick and the company made a real effort to install prior to Christmas in a busy time. This was much appreciated. Mitch and the install team were great. They arrived on time, talked me through everything and consulted on the best locations for the install. The install went very smoothly and the team took great care on my terracotta tiled roof. The only issue was a defective Wi-Fi dongle which Mitch then applied for a replacement under warranty and advised he would install when it arrived in the new year. Could not be happier with the experience from start to finish. Paul McLachlan
All good for above.
Good1 week delay due to weather conditions, Polite, TidyGood and tes
Steve from Sure Solar was great at communication and facilitated the grid connection. . The installation crew was polite, respectful, helpful, tidy in respect of their work practices and informative

Steve the salesperson did a wonderful job answering my many questions without visiting the site, which once would have meant losing our business, however Steve's persistence with my questions won the day and I am happy with the result, Even with the fact that I had to remove 2 of my wife's favorite trees.Overall a fantastic install. The team did a wonderful job working between the rain it was a miracle' They replaced the existing system, removed it from the premises, all in one day.  25 Panels on two levels.The reason for 4 stars for installation was the apprentice produced a gaping hole in our ceiling whilst installing the wiring although they were very polite and punctual throughout.The reason for 4 stars for customer service is twofold, the first being we changed plans with AGL and it necessitated a password change which took a couple of days and multiple phone calls, but was resolved successfully. One I got through he was very helpful and knowledgeable. The second reason is we finally (about 3 weeks) had the hole fixed but are still waiting for the resulting crack to be fixed.Vey happy with the result and I would refer Sure Solar to others.

The sales process was easy, and the sales person listened,  was knowledgeable, forthcoming  and didn't push any specific product.  He worked with us to get what was suitable and didn't push.  The installation process was well communicated, and easy.  Installers were on time, efficient and cleaned up after themselves!  The support team then organised our Meter Upgrade / Grid Connection! Very happy with Sure Solar!

Quoting process was easy. Of the three quotes I received, Sure Solar was the most straight forward and transparent. I’d already dealt with other solar companies who had particularly annoying service people, but Nick from Sure Solar was always prompt and professional and respectful of my time.Installation day was easy, and the end product is fantastic!
Good price, upgraded parts at little extra cost, speedy on time installation, good sales dept. What's not to like?

Received 3 quotes, I spoke to all 3 at length and after doing my own research on each, I asked  "if they did a discount for ex service members?",all 3 said (or words to that effect), 'I will get back to you, or speak to the boss ', only one did a discount, it was a good price and I signed the contract, installation was done in a few weeks, job well done.
Customise my solar system to meet my requirements:- save money for water heater- tree shade installation with patient, visit us a few times to set up all devices

Nick and the team from SureSolar did an excellent job with my install. I needed a powerful system installed on a difficult multi-roof house. The consultation process worked through the planning and options really well and despite rain delays the installation team were excellent and over came the challenges my house posed.Thanks SureSolar!

- Prompt response and tailored made proposals to our goals in installing a solar system.- Easy communication along the way- Install went well, friendly and tidy- Early days regarding performance but so far so good

Quoting by sure solar was the best, they provided multiple system configurations that we could choose from.Installation went as required, the only issue was they reversed a phase on the 3-phase aircon system, had to get that fixed the next day when the aircon didn't work.They organised grid connection

*Sales quoting process was excellent. Spent the time researching, designing, and discussing a number of options and for the installation that would suit the site and meet my needs. Was most helpful out of all the sales reps I dealt with. Ended with a site inspection also to double check everything.*Installation took longer than expected by a few days. This was out of the installers hands though with staff shortages due to COVID. The installers were polite, tidy and punctual and acheived what they said they would each day given the reduced man power available.*Have assisted with connection to grid and access to a high feed in tarrif also.

The quoting process was thorough and informative and follow up felt genuine and not pushy. I was at work while the installation happened with my parents in attendance and was told the installers were very thorough. However, given the Xmas period, I have not followed up for customer support and therefore I'm not connected to WiFi or even sure if I'm connected to the grid. I will follow up now given most companies should be back from holidays.

Sales & quoting process was very thorough, although they didn’t price match but do offer greater warranties and a 5 year operational performance guarantee. Customer service has generally been good with grid connection emails detailed clearly on the process.The installers were tidy, polite and kept us up to date throughout the install. However upon inspection the installation was unfortunately very disappointing. We thought everything was ok, until we had another company complete bird proofing and alerted us to two seperate end panels being incorrectly installed and not secured properly (missing clips, railing installed incorrectly and missing feet to secure it to the roof). Unfortunately it took two visits for this to be fixed & the only reason we realised the work hadn’t been completed the 2nd time was because we had electricians inspect the work. The Director has reached out to us after we sent through photos and videos and he was very apologetic and arranged to get things resolved quickly before Christmas.We also paid extra due to our roof being terracotta which resulted in some broken tiles, which the company has promised to fix properly.Overall, we’re very happy with the panels and inverter, customer service upon flagging issues has been satisfactory however the workmanship and installation has been poor on more than one occasion. If we had our time again we probably would have gone with another company based on the price and the issues we’ve had thus far.

Getting the quote and the right system was good, but once the deal was signed communication was poor. While the quote stated prompt (4-6 weeks) installation the first attempt was after 6 weeks. It failed because Sure Solar did not check whether the panels would be actually in the warehouse on the day of installation. They were not. I had to chase new dates and in the end four more weeks later they were professionally installed by the sub contractor Solid Solar and they deserve the 5*. 2 weeks after installation I still do not have all the documentation. I can certainly recommend Solid Solar but not Sure Solar.

They  offered good communications while chasing the sale and new information for me to make the battery add-on have a better ROI however I feel that was at perhaps incomplete about the function of the battery system, once the sale was complete it was radio silence from the Sure solar team (minus my SMS to sales chasing what was happening) and it was only when I was at the point of asking for a refund on my deposit did I finally get a call from the subcontractor to book the pre-install site visit.to be clear this was during the Sydney lock-down so some delay could have been expected but no email. phone call or SMS. Even the company number goes to an answering service so if you want to talk to someone good luck with that. for over 3 weeks.At this point even though it had been almost 4 weeks from the payment of the deposit to the pre-site visit was at this point that the order for the battery was placed. unsurprisingly with the current global supply chain issues there was no stock and i was told I would need to wait up to 6 weeks for one to become available. Again I would have thought that when the deposit was paid would be used to secure stock for the committed install date.During the installation from the sub-contractor it was advised that the install design would not meet my requirements and was lucky enough that the team on-site agreed to modify the design(for a fee) to perform in the function that was desired( charge off the solar in the even of a power outage (DC coupled system)).
